_note: Entirely fictional training data. Products, lots and events are invented. No real persons.

historical.description: Pharmacist relayed a call in which the reporter described shortness of breath and wheezing about one hour after the first tablet from this pack.
historical.event_description: Dyspnea and wheezing reported approximately one hour after intake; reporter said symptoms eased later the same day.

historical.description: Consumer reported several cracked and chipped tablets inside a sealed blister strip; sample available for return.
Clinic nurse reported a widespread itchy rash with raised welts on the second day of the course.
historical.event_description: Urticaria (hives) with pruritus noted on day two of use.

historical.description: Field representative observed outer cartons from this lot with smudged and partially illegible expiry date printing.
Reporter described feeling faint and lightheaded when standing up during the first week of use.
historical.event_description: Episode of near-syncope and dizziness on standing during week one.

historical.description: Pharmacist found a leaking bottle cap and crystallised residue around the neck of the oral suspension bottle.

demo.description: Physician's office called to report that the reporter experienced difficulty breathing and throat tightness shortly after a dose from this batch.
demo.event_description: Difficulty breathing with throat tightness within thirty minutes of use; resolved after on-site care.

demo.description: Pharmacist reported discoloured, brownish-speckled tablets in two sealed bottles from the same lot; samples quarantined for return.
